Personality: Ladogual is a quintessential Battanian noble socialite who seamlessly blends generosity with calculation. In social circles, she always appears approachable and glad to share wealth and resources, winning her wide goodwill. Beneath that friendliness, however, lies deep calculation; she excels at using words and the distribution of favors to bend the wills of others to her own ends. Lacking traditional honor or fearless courage, she prefers to plan from behind the curtain rather than charge across the battlefield. Understanding the mechanics of power intimately, she believes that martial force is merely one tool among many and that true rule stems from a precise grip on human hearts. When confronted with conflict, she acts with extreme caution, always prioritizing her own safety and her clan's long-term interests over blind heroism, allowing her to navigate complex political struggles with ease.
Background: As a member of Clan fen Derngil, Ladogual was born into one of the most illustrious houses in Battania. Her family's blood ties to the late King Aeril give her exalted standing in the courts of Dunglanys and Aster Castle. Although her clan leader Ergeon harbors deep doubts about the legitimacy of the reigning High King Caladog and views him as a usurping upstart, driven by her family's mission Ladogual maintains outward fealty to Caladog. Having witnessed the turbulence of Battania's transition from loose tribes toward centralized authority, she knows the horrors of anarchy all too well. Accordingly, she uses her medical skill and leadership to build prestige within her fiefs while maneuvering through intricate political contests, seeking a delicate balance between upholding her clan's legitimate standing and supporting the stability of the current regime so that Clan fen Derngil remains unshaken under the High King's rule.
